name: Hotel Montana
beschreibung: Hotel Montana is set in a peaceful location at the entrance to Telfes im Stubaital. The surrounding peaks of the Stubai Alps provide a scenic environment for summer hiking trails and swift winter transit to the Stubai Glacier and the Schlick 2000 ski area. The hotel features functional guest rooms with mountain-view balconies, an on-site sauna, a fitness room, and an authentic restaurant serving hearty regional meals.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Montana in Telfes im Stubaital offers quiet alpine lodging, a sauna, a fitness room, balcony rooms, and convenient access to the Stubai Glacier.
